cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.0)

# Characterization tests for Snowflake type to SQL C type conversions
# These tests capture the exact behavior of the OLD ODBC driver to ensure
# the NEW driver behaves identically.
#
# Test files are generated by scripts/generate_characterization_tests.sh
# Each file tests one specific conversion (e.g., varchar_to_sql_c_numeric.cpp)
#
# By default, characterization tests are SKIPPED.
# To run them, set the environment variable: RUN_CHARACTERIZATION=1
#
# Example:
#   RUN_CHARACTERIZATION=1 ctest -R characterization

# Collect all .cpp files in this directory
file(GLOB CHARACTERIZATION_TEST_SOURCES "*.cpp")

# Create a separate test for each .cpp file
foreach(TEST_SOURCE ${CHARACTERIZATION_TEST_SOURCES})
    # Extract filename without extension for test name
    get_filename_component(TEST_NAME ${TEST_SOURCE} NAME_WE)
    set(TEST_TARGET "characterization_${TEST_NAME}")
    
    # Create executable
    add_executable(${TEST_TARGET} ${TEST_SOURCE})
    target_link_libraries(${TEST_TARGET} PRIVATE Catch2::Catch2WithMain ODBC::ODBC common)
    target_include_directories(${TEST_TARGET} PRIVATE ${picojson_SOURCE_DIR})
    
    # Add test with skip logic - skipped by default unless RUN_CHARACTERIZATION is set
    add_test(NAME ${TEST_TARGET}
        COMMAND sh -c "if [ \"\${RUN_CHARACTERIZATION:-}\" ]; then $<TARGET_FILE:${TEST_TARGET}> ${CATCH_TAGS}; else exit 127; fi"
    )
    set_tests_properties(${TEST_TARGET} PROPERTIES
        SKIP_RETURN_CODE 127
        LABELS "characterization"
    )
endforeach()
